title: Runbook Checklist Steps Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runbook:checklist steps_completed=*
| stats sum(steps_completed) as total_value, avg(steps_completed) as avg_value by checklist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks checklist name values by total and average steps completed across runbook checklist events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `steps_completed` values for each runbook checklist event and review total and average steps completed by checklist name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total steps completed.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It produces which checklist name shows the biggest steps completed numbers in your runbook checklist data.
